title: LatchGitPushPreviewV2
description: GET /v2/git/push/preview?path=&remote=&destination=&cursor= at the control grant: what a push of the current branch would send, as last fetched. Read-only and offline: it never contacts the remote. Without remote and destination it reviews the branch's upstream; a branch without an upstream on a remote is never given a destination silently (selectionRequired). The phone sends remote, remoteUrl, destination, sourceBranch, sourceOid and destinationOid back with POST /v2/git/push, which is refused with refresh_required if any of them moved.

remote.description: Remote name, as `git remote` lists it.

remoteUrl.description: The URL a push to this remote uses (pushurl if set), with any user name or password removed.

destination.description: Branch name on the remote, such as main.

destinationRef.description: Full destination ref on the remote, refs/heads/<destination>.

trackingRef.description: The local remote-tracking ref for the destination, such as refs/remotes/origin/main; null when the remote's fetch configuration maps it nowhere.

destinationOid.description: The destination's commit as last fetched; null when this Mac has not seen it. Never proof of what the remote holds now.

selectedBy.description: upstream: the branch's configured upstream. request: the remote and destination the phone named.

newBranch.description: The destination was not known to exist as of the last fetch; the push would create it.

isDefaultBranch.description: The destination is the remote's default branch as last fetched (refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD). Informational; it goes through the same review.

reconciliation.description: POST /v2/git/push/reconcile: the push receipt after the host asked the remote (git ls-remote, the user's explicit action) where the destination is now. The receipt is settled only when the evidence decides it; otherwise it stays uncertain.

remoteChecked.description: The remote answered. False: it could not be reached (message says why) and the receipt is unchanged.

remoteOid.description: Where the destination is on the remote now; null when it does not exist or was not checked.

message.description: One plain sentence on what the check found.

source.description: The local branch a push would send and its commit. Null on a detached or unborn HEAD.

target.description: The reviewed remote and destination; null while a destination must still be chosen.

selectionRequired.description: No destination was chosen and the branch has no upstream on a remote: the phone must have the user pick a remote and destination explicitly.

suggestion.description: A remote and destination name the phone may pre-fill for the user to confirm. Never pushed to without that confirmation.

ahead.description: Commits the push would send, as last fetched.

behind.description: Commits on the destination (as last fetched) that the source lacks.

blockedReason.description: Why nothing can be pushed from this state, as one sentence; null when a push can be offered.

rejectionLikelyReason.description: Why the remote will probably refuse a normal push (the destination has commits the source lacks). Git still decides.

outgoing.description: Commits the push would send, newest first, one page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; refused with stale_cursor once the source or destination moves.
